metadata.provenance_policy: Working dataset consists of mixed provenance: 3 existing/source-derived logs (including 1 benchmarked) and 8 AI-assisted reconstructions. Downstream models and statistics are conditioned partly on AI-reconstructed intervals.

litholog1.notes: Original existing dataset log. Not generated by current AI reconstruction workflow. Independent validation against original field notes is undocumented/unknown.
